content: Compose animation pitfalls: 1) Unstable lambdas causing mass recomposition (use function references or remember). 2) Reading animation/scroll state in the composition phase instead of layout/draw phase, leading to jank (use lambda modifiers like Modifier.offset { ... }). 3) Mutating lists in place instead of using mutableStateListOf. 4) State-driven animation must decouple backend calls from visual reveals.
